additional_info.subject: Description
additional_info.body:
Customer reports many zero sessions on this charger.
When looking in the logs I can see that the charger has alot of zero sessions as the customer clames, however cannot get a clear picture.
The failed sessions are on all 4 plugs almost evenly.
I can see they fail because of feedback error from the contactors, however I can't bellive that so many different contactors can have issues on this charger.
What could be the issue?
